item.description:
## Full-window surface alignment
- Removes the remaining vertical inset around the two-pane Studio surface so the sidebar and Canvas reach the native window's top and bottom content boundaries cleanly. - Keeps the finite viewport layout that prevents macOS 26 from vertically centering or clipping the sidebar header, connection footer, and Canvas content. - Preserves the existing theme application, bundled theme library, DockDoor launcher, and Sparkle update behavior.

## Single titlebar hierarchy
- Removes the redundant in-app command band beneath the macOS titlebar so Canvas and Themes begin directly below one consistent native window chrome. - Keeps the repaired split-view sizing and pinned sidebar footer from 0.1.8, including the fully visible connection status and “Open themed Codex” action at compact window sizes. - Preserves the existing theme application, local Apple wallpaper shelves, DockDoor launcher, and Sparkle update behavior.

## Native titlebar and sidebar layout repair
- Separates the Codex Studio content surface from the macOS titlebar on macOS 26 so the sidebar brand and Canvas command bar no longer draw underneath the traffic lights or titlebar. - Gives the split view a stable vertical viewport and pins the sidebar footer so the connection status and “Open themed Codex” action remain fully visible at compact window sizes. - Keeps the existing theme application, local Apple wallpaper shelves, DockDoor launcher, and Sparkle update behavior unchanged.
